Disclaimer: This is a joke obby. This is not meant to be taken seriously.

Someone's broke the announcer speaker box and you have to recover him, but someone broke the HPRC too! Your objective is to find the missing part of the machine and recover the announcer, but that still leaves one question. Who could've done this? Go through 27 different stages to find out!
